import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
paths=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.jpg')][:20]
for n in paths:
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    open(p,'wb').write(z.read(n))
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',f'./submit.sh {p} /workspace/candidate_trace.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(n, r.returncode, r.stdout.splitlines()[:3], r.stderr.splitlines()[:3])
